paragraphs: Mentioned in [Yevamot 115b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.115b.11), in the time of Rabbah bar Avuha. This is not the name of a sage.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Yevamot reads Nanai bar Chavai, next to Chavai bar Nanai, as creditors named on documents from Mechoza. It names Rava bar Avuha in the case.
Hyman’s notice gives Nagai and Rabbah bar Avuha and classifies the person as someone other than a sage.
